records.operational_notes: We have been using more printer ribbons since the new warehouse opened. The supplier was late for the last two deliveries. If we run out, staff may not be able to print dispatch documents on time.

Hose usage has stayed about the same, and the supplier usually delivers on time. The maintenance team needs this hose for next week's servicing. If we do not have a replacement, the machine cannot be used safely until the repair is done.
We used more tape than usual last week for a large packing job. The job is now finished, so tape usage should return to normal. The supplier has been delivering orders on time.

We found three damaged pressure sensors during the latest inspection, and they cannot be used. We do not know when the replacements will arrive. These sensors help us check equipment condition, and running out may delay checks and repairs.

We have been using more gloves because there are more maintenance shifts. The supplier warned us that the next delivery may be late. If we run out of gloves, some maintenance work must stop until suitable gloves are available.

The machine that uses this filter was taken out of service last month. We have not checked the recorded usage since then, so it may not show how many filters we need now. Check whether the filter is still needed before placing another order.
